contexts.text: The affections of what is false originating from the delights of the loves of self and of the world, are represented by wild beasts, as by panthers, tigers, etc.
Afar off (these violaters) appear like panthers.
Some of the satyrs had feet like calves, some like panthers, and some like wolves.
The satyrs who in respect to their feet appeared like panthers, spoke about nature... and religion. (Their sentiments.)
I told them that I had seen... six of them as pantherine satyrs.
A man not reformed is as to his spirit like a panther... (and) how can a panther man be turned into a sheep man... by any imputation... TCR 642.
They walk about (in the city) like panthers in sheep's clothing...
The panthers, tigers, etc., rushed on the Hock...
When at worship, he would appear (to the Angels) to be dancing about like a panther's cub.
Gustavus Adolphus... was presently represented by a certain deceitful animal = a small panther, which crossed over to the left side.
In the Hell of assassins and poisoners there appear as it were tigers and panthers...
8. Those who are like panthers scent murderers and assassins; revenge is delightful to them.
